text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hawa...! S-So cute...! Huddled together 
with their tiny little bodies...! Ah, I 
want to protect them... I want to protect 
them so bad, I can't—

text_block_list.name: Person Playing Catch
text_block_list.text:
—Aah!? Look out! Hey lady, watch out for 
the ball!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Should I consider it a blessing 
that it hit me instead of the cats?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to leave such an easy opening... 
As a martial artist, I am far too... Ugh, 
inexperienced...!"
